description: Derived financial intelligence for a Romanian company: multi-year revenue trend (YoY, 3/5/10-year CAGR), margins, headcount, solvency and liquidity ratios, a 0-100 health score with its rule-by-rule breakdown, red flags, and peer percentiles within the same CAEN activity and county. Verdict: 'growing', 'stable' or 'distressed'. Use lookup_financials for the raw figures.
name: lookup_financial_ratios
